name: Memory: zram swap, no rounded-corner overlay
description: For the 4 GB curtana. HarmonyOS (made for the 12 GB Pura 70) ran with ~100 MB free and no swap, which made input and UI lag badly: a boot script turns on zram (lz4, 75% of RAM, swappiness 100). render_service also tried to draw the Pura 70's rounded-corner overlay (RCD) on every frame and failed every time; persist.rosen.screenroundcornerrcd.enabled is set to 0.
